title: DO NOT BUY! Arrived broken and they do NOT snap together!!
text: DO NOT BUY! Arrived broken and they do NOT snap together!!. Over half of the bulbs are cracked. They also do NOT snap together at all! I realize there are supposed to be 2 different sides that fit together. I tried several in different sleeves in the package. Buyer beware of this product! Definitely returning!
